messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up — onboarding for Lazuli Health shows 18% higher p95 latency and token costs trending +24% vs baseline after 48h. Seeing a large tail for long prompts. Could be batching or model size mismatch.

sam_eng: thanks — can you paste the recent perf snapshot?

maria_cs: attached snippet from console: `model: redwood-xl-7b`, `route: hosted-default`, `avg_seq: 420`, `p95_ms: 412`, `tokens_per_call: 1.9`. Also customer is on free tier bursts; dedicated not enabled.

sam_eng: got it. long sequences + bigger model = cost hit. quick options: 1) suggest compact model (redwood-compact-3b-int8) canary 2) enable prefix KV caching for repeated system prompts 3) route long requests to dedicated pool with higher batching.

raj_research: FYI quality delta for redwood-compact-3b-int8 vs xl-7b on their eval set is small for instruction-following. We ran the A/B on 500 samples — mean ROUGE diff was -0.6. Risk seems acceptable if we monitor.

ellie_se: I'll coordinate the customer message. Proposed outreach: offer a short A/B pilot (2k calls) with compact model + canary routing, highlight 20–30% cost savings. Want to confirm no feature regressions before we offer.

maria_cs: sounds good. can we provide a quick canary plan that ops can run without touching prod?

sam_eng: plan: create a canary route `lazuli-canary-compact`, policy: 10% rollout for 48h, autoscale min=1, max=4. Add fallback to xl-7b on quality alerts. Config snippet: 
``
route: lazuli-canary-compact
model: redwood-compact-3b-int8
rollout: 0.1
monitoring: perf + quality (sampling 1%)
fallback: redwood-xl-7b
```

sam_eng: also enable prefix caching for their repeated intake prompt: `cache_prefix: true, ttl: 3600s` — should cut tokens per call for common prompts.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment created: lazuli-canary-compact -> 10% traffic. Health checks passing (3/3). URL: https://console.redwood.example/deploys/6112223334/canary

raj_research: add a lightweight eval that samples 200 recent calls and compares hallucination rate + critical term recall. If delta > 1.5% trigger rollback.

ellie_se: I'll sync with Lazuli PM — propose pilot start tomorrow 10am PT, share expected savings and the rollback criteria.

maria_cs: thanks team. action items: @sam_eng set canary alerts and sample eval; @raj_research add auto-check; @ellie_se send customer note + opt-in link. I'll follow up in 24h with customer feedback. :thumbsup:
